	LR_dec_pw_orleans_a = {
		icon = generic_political_discourse
		cost = 25
		days_re_enable = 30
		visible = { has_country_flag = LR_route_orleans }

				}

				clamp_variable = { var = LR_pw min = 0 max = 100 }

		}
